definitions.gloss: the secular world; mundane society; the everyday world
definitions.explanation: The ordinary world of human society, as opposed to the spiritual, religious, or transcendent realm. Often used to describe the world of everyday concerns, social customs, and material life.

examples.japanese: {俗世間|ぞくせけん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{離|はな}れて→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: To live apart from the mundane world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{俗世間|ぞくせけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: He has no interest in worldly matters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}えて→終える：02019_oeru⟧{俗世間|ぞくせけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}った→戻る：01117_modoru⟧とき、すべて⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}って→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: When I returned to the secular world after completing my training, everything looked different.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{俗|ぞく}→俗：24364_zoku⟧ (common; vulgar; secular) and ⟦{世間|せけん}→世間：03299_seken⟧ (the world; society). Carries a connotation of the ordinary, unenlightened, or materially concerned world, contrasted with spiritual or ascetic life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {俗世間|ぞくせけん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{離|はな}れる→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧: to withdraw from the secular world
- {俗世間|ぞくせけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧: to return to the everyday world
- {俗世間|ぞくせけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{煩|わずら}い: worldly troubles
- {俗世間|ぞくせけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧: social obligations of everyday life

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{世間|せけん}→世間：03299_seken⟧: society; the world — the general term for society and public opinion, without the spiritual contrast
- {俗世|ぞくせ}: the secular world — a shorter, more literary form with the same meaning
- {浮世|うきよ}: the floating world; transient world — carries Buddhist connotations of life's impermanence, or refers to the pleasure quarters of Edo-period Japan
- ⟦{現世|げんせ}→現世：20421_gense⟧: this world; the present life — used in Buddhist contexts to contrast with afterlife or past lives
